raw:
{
  "items": [
    {
      "category": "domain_extent",
      "entity": "MBB design-domain dimensions",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Appendix C specifies 144 x 48 elements but gives no side lengths or element spacings. The domain aspect ratio therefore requires an unstated square-element assumption.",
      "readings": [
        "Domain [0,3] x [0,1], with square elements of side 1/48.",
        "Domain [0,6] x [0,1], with element spacings 1/24 horizontally and 1/48 vertically.",
        "Domain [0,144] x [0,48], with unit square elements."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "domain_extent",
      "entity": "Full versus symmetry-reduced beam",
      "issue": "vague",
      "description": "Appendix C invokes 'standard MBB beam boundary conditions' without defining whether the stated mesh represents the entire beam or a symmetry-reduced portion.",
      "readings": [
        "The 144 x 48 mesh represents one half of a beam reconstructed by reflection.",
        "The 144 x 48 mesh represents the entire computational beam, without symmetry reduction."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "domain_extent",
      "entity": "Uniform out-of-plane thickness",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Appendix C specifies plane stress but does not specify the thickness used to assemble stiffness.",
      "readings": [
        "Uniform thickness t=1 with the stated unit nodal force.",
        "Uniform thickness t=0.1 with the stated unit nodal force."
      ],
      "effect": "scale_only"
    },
    {
      "category": "support_location_extent",
      "entity": "MBB support and symmetry locations",
      "issue": "vague",
      "description": "The 'standard MBB' reference in Appendix C does not explicitly identify constrained nodes, edges, or support-patch extents.",
      "readings": [
        "Constrain the entire left edge for symmetry and support the single bottom-right node.",
        "Constrain the entire left edge for symmetry and support the bottom boundary over the rightmost element width.",
        "Support the bottom-left and bottom-right corner nodes, with no whole-edge symmetry condition."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "support_type",
      "entity": "Displacement components restrained at MBB supports",
      "issue": "vague",
      "description": "Appendix C does not translate 'standard MBB beam boundary conditions' into displacement-component constraints.",
      "readings": [
        "Left-edge symmetry restrains ux only; the bottom-right support restrains uy only.",
        "A bottom-left pin restrains ux and uy; a bottom-right roller restrains uy only.",
        "Left-edge symmetry restrains ux only; the bottom-right support restrains both ux and uy."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "load_direction",
      "entity": "Unit force at the top-left node",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Appendix C specifies the force magnitude and node but gives no explicit force vector.",
      "readings": [
        "Vertical downward force: (fx,fy)=(0,-1).",
        "Vertical upward force: (fx,fy)=(0,1).",
        "Inclined downward-right force: (fx,fy)=(1/sqrt(2),-1/sqrt(2))."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "passive_region",
      "entity": "Elements adjoining the MBB load and supports",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Neither Sec. 5 nor Appendix C specifies whether load or support neighborhoods contain prescribed solid material or how such material would enter the volume budget.",
      "readings": [
        "All 144 x 48 elements are designable; no passive solid regions.",
        "Fix one element adjoining each load or support location to solid and count these elements within the 30% budget.",
        "Use the same fixed solid elements but apply the 30% budget only to the remaining designable elements."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "mesh",
      "entity": "Q4 element stiffness integration",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Appendix C identifies bilinear Q4 plane-stress elements but does not specify their integration or stabilization.",
      "readings": [
        "Fully integrated Q4 elements using 2 x 2 Gauss quadrature.",
        "One-point reduced-integration Q4 elements with hourglass stabilization."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "Units and metric for the density-filter radius",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Eq. (16), Appendix C, and Table 1 give numerical radii without specifying whether distances use physical coordinates or element-index coordinates.",
      "readings": [
        "Measure distance in element-index coordinates; r_min=2 spans two grid spacings.",
        "Measure distance in physical coordinates; r_min=2 means two domain-length units."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "Lower bound on r_min in the Fig. 5 experiment",
      "issue": "conflicting",
      "description": "Sec. 5.1 states that the lower bound is 2.0, whereas Table 1 gives 1.5 for the four-hyperparameter experiment.",
      "readings": [
        "Constrain r_min to [2.0,10.0].",
        "Constrain r_min to [1.5,10.0]."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "volume_fraction",
      "entity": "Volume enforcement through filtering and Heaviside projection",
      "issue": "vague",
      "description": "The 30% target is explicit, but Eq. (14) constrains pre-filter densities. Sec. 5 allows either fixed or adaptive eta_h without selecting the MBB policy; Eq. (16) need not preserve the global density sum.",
      "readings": [
        "Enforce 30% on tilde_rho and use eta_h=0.5; accept the resulting physical volume.",
        "Enforce 30% on tilde_rho and choose eta_h to preserve the filtered-field volume across Heaviside projection.",
        "Enforce 30% on tilde_rho and choose eta_h so the final physical density also occupies exactly 30%."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "Sigmoidal volume projection Phi",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 5 describes a shifted parametric sigmoid but does not give its functional form or steepness.",
      "readings": [
        "Phi_e=1/(1+exp(-(z_e+b))), with b chosen for the volume constraint.",
        "Phi_e=(1+tanh(z_e+b))/2, with b chosen for the volume constraint."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "Adaptive projection-root implementation",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 5 specifies bisection for Phi and optionally eta_h, but omits stopping accuracy and how threshold dependence enters design gradients.",
      "readings": [
        "Solve to a volume-fraction residual below 1e-8 and differentiate the volume equation implicitly.",
        "Use 40 bisection iterations and automatic differentiation through the implemented iterations.",
        "Solve to a volume-fraction residual below 1e-6 and hold the solved threshold constant during differentiation."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "Initial beta, p, and r_min for Fig. 5",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 5.1 mentions four initial beta values without listing them and gives no initial p or r_min. Appendix C's fixed p=3 and r_min=2 apply to the separate two-dimensional landscape experiment.",
      "readings": [
        "Use beta initializations {0.05,0.5,1,5}, with p_initial=3 and r_min_initial=2.",
        "Use beta initializations {0.1,1,5,10}, with p_initial=1 and r_min_initial=4."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "CNN spatial upsampling sequence",
      "issue": "conflicting",
      "description": "Appendix C.1 starts at Nx/8 by Ny/8, describes five layers each doubling resolution, and also requires the output to match Nx by Ny. Three doublings reach 144 x 48; five reach 576 x 192.",
      "readings": [
        "Use three doubling blocks: 18 x 6 to 36 x 12 to 72 x 24 to 144 x 48.",
        "Use five hidden blocks, with three doubling blocks and two blocks that retain spatial resolution.",
        "Use five doubling blocks followed by resizing to 144 x 48."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "Remaining CNN layer specifications",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Appendix C.1 refers externally for full details and omits convolution widths, kernels, padding, output mapping, and layer-normalization axes and epsilon.",
      "readings": [
        "Use 32 channels throughout hidden layers, 3 x 3 same-padded convolutions, a linear one-channel output, and whole-feature-map normalization with epsilon=1e-5.",
        "Use hidden widths 32,16,8,4,4, 5 x 5 same-padded convolutions, a tanh one-channel output, and per-pixel channel normalization with epsilon=1e-6."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "CNN and latent-vector initialization",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 5.1 and Appendix C do not identify initialization distributions, scales, or seeds for Fig. 5. The uniform 0.3 initialization in C.2 applies to the standard parameterization.",
      "readings": [
        "Glorot-uniform weights, zero biases, standard-normal latent entries, and seeds 0 through 4.",
        "Glorot-normal weights, zero biases, standard-normal latent entries, and seeds 5 through 9."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "Shared UL normalization constants",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Eq. (18) and Appendix C specify fixed c_ref and d_ref obtained from a random network initialization but supply neither their values nor the identified reference initialization.",
      "readings": [
        "Compute both reference values from a separate fixed reference network with seed 0.",
        "Compute both reference values from a separate fixed reference network with seed 1."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "Adam moment coefficients",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 3 specifies Adam, numerical safeguards, and LL state resets, but not the first- and second-moment decay coefficients used at either level.",
      "readings": [
        "Use moment coefficients (0.9,0.999) at both levels.",
        "Use (0.9,0.99) at the LL and (0.9,0.999) at the UL."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "Initial LL unrolling horizon",
      "issue": "vague",
      "description": "Sec. 3 permits t_start=1 or 2, but Appendix C assigns no MBB-specific value. Appendix A's reserve for t=1 does not explicitly settle the choice.",
      "readings": [
        "Start with t_start=1.",
        "Start with t_start=2."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "Total computational budget for Fig. 5",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Algorithm 1 requires B_max, but Sec. 5 and Appendix C provide no numerical total budget for this example.",
      "readings": [
        "Terminate at 10000 linear solves.",
        "Terminate at 20000 linear solves."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "Computational-budget accounting unit",
      "issue": "conflicting",
      "description": "Sec. 3 and Appendix A.1 call the budget cumulative LL iterations, whereas Algorithm 1 increments it by 4t+2 and Appendix C.3 compares linear solves.",
      "readings": [
        "Count actual LL optimizer updates, adding t per BOTH UL iteration.",
        "Count linear solves, adding 4t+2 per BOTH UL iteration."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "Initial-learning-rate probe grid",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Appendix A.4 introduces N geometric candidates without assigning N; 'at most 20 trials' is only a cost bound. Appendix C gives the resulting learning rate approximately.",
      "readings": [
        "Use 10 geometric candidates over [1e-8,1].",
        "Use 20 geometric candidates over [1e-8,1]."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    }
  ]
}
